newsitem.title: SPAIN: Last of 1981 failed Spanish coup leaders freed.
newsitem.headline: Last of 1981 failed Spanish coup leaders freed.

text.p: Spain released ex-Civil Guard officer Antonio Tejero from a Madrid prison on Tuesday -- the last of the rebels jailed for a 1981 coup attempt, police said.
Tejero, 64, broke into the Spanish Congress on February 23, 1981 and held deputies at gunpoint for several hours as millions of television viewers watched.

He was acting under orders from former Lieutenant-General Jaime Milans who as commanding officer of the Third Military Region based in Valencia mobilised about 1,800 troops later that day and declared a military government in the region.
Milans withdrew his troops early on February 24 only after a telephone conversation with King Juan Carlos.

Tejero, who served 16 years of his 30-year sentence, has been free to leave Madrid's Alcala prison during the day and weekends for the past three years. On Tuesday he was granted complete liberty conditional on his not committing any crime.
